rows.text: returns without a write when `rcx` is null or when the whole of `edx` equals bit 5 of dword `rcx+0xC8`; otherwise replaces bit 5 of that dword with bit 0 of `edx` and walks the two qwords at `+0xC8` and `+0xD0` of qword `+0xC0` of qword `02B62D88`, calling `00406DD0` + 0x7B with the entry in `rcx` and the incoming `edx` for each entry that is non-null and has bit 4 (0x10) of byte `+0x130` set, skipping it when qword `02B62D88`, its `+0xC0` qword or the entry is null or that bit is clear
